channel.title: Radio 2 in the Park
channel.desc: The 'queen of funk', Chaka Khan, headlines the first day of Radio 2 in the Park live from Stirling, bringing her powerhouse vocals, legendary hits and five decades' worth of soul and funk to the stage. Join the global superstar for an unforgettable headline performance packed with classic songs, incredible energy and the unmistakable voice that has made her a music icon.
